label: null_ctx0

label: fq6_profile_12345678_id_abcd_uint8_42
description: FullyQualifiedTag(profile=0x12345678,id=0xABCD) PutUint(_, 42) → control=0xC4, profile uint32 LE + id uint16 LE — verified against matter.js TlvCodec.writeTag (FullyQualified48)

label: fq8_profile_12345678_id_deadbeef_uint8_42
description: FullyQualifiedTag(profile=0x12345678,id=0xDEADBEEF) PutUint(_, 42) → control=0xE4, profile uint32 LE + id uint32 LE — verified against matter.js TlvCodec.writeTag (FullyQualified64)

label: implicit2_id_1234_uint8_42
description: ImplicitTag(0x1234) PutUint(_, 42) → control=0x84, id uint16 LE (0x1234), value 0x2A. matter.js encoder does not emit (TlvCodec.writeTag has no ImplicitProfile branch); spec-derived bytes per Matter Core §A.7.2 — see docs/parity/by_design.md.

label: implicit4_id_12345678_uint8_42
description: ImplicitTag(0x12345678) PutUint(_, 42) → control=0xA4, id uint32 LE (0x12345678), value 0x2A. matter.js encoder does not emit (TlvCodec.writeTag has no ImplicitProfile branch); spec-derived bytes per Matter Core §A.7.2 — see docs/parity/by_design.md.

label: utf8_anon_len300
description: PutUTF8(AnonymousTag, 'a' x 300) — exercises the 2-byte-length prefix (TypeUtf8Str2, control 0x0D), length 300 = 0x012C LE, body 300 'a' bytes. Verified against matter.js TlvCodec.

label: uint8_ctx0_FF_nullable_sentinel
description: PutUint(ContextTag(0), 0xFF) — locks the matter.js encoding for the uint8 nullable sentinel (the value chosen by Matter as 'null' for nullable uint8 attributes). control=0x24, tag=0x00, value=0xFF.

label: uint16_ctx0_FFFF_nullable_sentinel
description: PutUint(ContextTag(0), 0xFFFF) — locks the matter.js encoding for the uint16 nullable sentinel. control=0x25, tag=0x00, value=FF FF.

label: float32_ctx0_1
description: PutFloat32(ContextTag(0), 1.0) — locks float32 with a context tag. control=(TagKindContext<<5)|TypeFloat4=0x2A, tag=0x00, IEEE-754 LE 0x3F800000. Mirrors matter.js TlvCodec.writeTag ContextTag + writeFloat.

label: float64_ctx1_1
description: PutFloat64(ContextTag(1), 1.0) — locks float64 with a context tag. control=(TagKindContext<<5)|TypeFloat8=0x2B, tag=0x01, IEEE-754 LE 0x3FF0000000000000. Mirrors matter.js TlvCodec.writeTag ContextTag + writeDouble.

label: int_anon_0
description: PutInt(AnonymousTag, 0) — int8 auto-width, smallest signed magnitude. control=TypeSignedInt1=0x00, payload=0x00.

label: int_anon_42
description: PutInt(AnonymousTag, 42) — int8 auto-width, positive mid-range. control=TypeSignedInt1=0x00, payload=0x2A.

label: int_anon_127
description: PutInt(AnonymousTag, 127) — int8 auto-width, signed int8 maximum. control=TypeSignedInt1=0x00, payload=0x7F.

label: int8_ctx0_nullable_sentinel
description: PutInt(ContextTag(0), -128) — int8 nullable sentinel per Matter §6.6.4.5 Table 26. control=(TagKindContext<<5)|TypeSignedInt1=0x20, tag=0x00, payload=0x80 (two's-complement). PutInt8Bounded must REJECT this value.

label: int16_ctx0_nullable_sentinel
description: PutInt16(ContextTag(0), -32768) — int16 nullable sentinel per Matter §6.6.4.5 Table 26. control=(TagKindContext<<5)|TypeSignedInt2=0x21, tag=0x00, payload=0x00 0x80 (LE two's-complement). PutInt16Bounded must REJECT this value.

label: int32_ctx0_nullable_sentinel
description: PutInt32(ContextTag(0), -2147483648) — int32 nullable sentinel per Matter §6.6.4.5 Table 26. control=(TagKindContext<<5)|TypeSignedInt4=0x22, tag=0x00, payload=0x00 0x00 0x00 0x80 (LE two's-complement). PutInt32Bounded must REJECT this value.
